ayahOccurrences.text: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ثَاقِبٌ is in the derivative form: ثَاقِبٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ث/ق/ب   th–q–b to bore, to perforate, to puncture, to pierce a hole; to heighten; to kindle, to light, to shine up. Of this root, ثَاقِبٌ thāqib occurs 2 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ثَاقِبٌ thāqib [act. part.] piercing, piercing bright

(37:10) إِلاَّ مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ except for he who snatches away a fragment, and he is pursued by a piercing flame.
